rules.joint_within_a_game: one mask over shared simulated worlds — never a product of marginals
rules.joint_across_games: product, because each game is a separate simulation with its own seed

prop_distribution_health.final_decision: DISTRIBUTION CHALLENGER REMAINS EXPERIMENTAL — champion distribution unchanged (TARGET_SHARE_NOISE_SD=CARRY_SHARE_NOISE_SD=0.30, DISTRIBUTION_VERSION=1). The audited pathology is predominantly LOW-BIASED CENTERS (weeks 1-2 especially: F(median)=.33 in the 25-55 band), which no honest width change fixes; widths in meaningful projection bands are approximately calibrated (cov80 tie-aware .78-.84 vs nominal .80). prop_distribution_health.explainer: F(qX) is the tie-aware share of outcomes below the predicted X% quantile — calibrated when it equals X%. cov80 is F(q90)-F(q10), nominal .80. qloss is the pinball average (proper score; lower is better). Raw inclusive coverage is inflated by the zero atom and no longer quoted.

conventions.straight_stake: flat 1 unit risked per graded Official Pick at its frozen executed FanDuel price
conventions.parlay_stake: 1 unit total per published frozen ticket (never per leg)
conventions.parlay_payout: winning tickets earn profit only from an authoritative frozen combined ticket price; leg-price products never feed official P/L — wins without one are counted as payout unavailable
conventions.missing_price: no price is ever assumed, reconstructed, or taken from closing odds
conventions.unit_display: dollars are computed client-side as units x the locally chosen unit value (default $100)
